name: Idol Words
overview: Scripture emphasizes the profound impact of our words, urging believers to guard their speech carefully. Psalms 141:3 models a prayer for divine protection over the mouth, while Proverbs highlights the wisdom in restraining excessive words and the life-giving power of wholesome speech. Jesus warns in Matthew 12:36 that every idle word will be accounted for on the day of judgment, underscoring the seriousness of careless talk. Ephesians further instructs believers to avoid corrupt or vain words, promoting speech that builds up others and steers clear of deception that brings God's wrath.
